risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI Agent Resource Limiting, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Fraud / Theft / Direct Financial Loss (R-EX-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13).

compensating_control_1.name: Capacity & Performance Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of capacity management controls to ensure optimal system performance to meet expected and anticipated future capacity requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Capacity & Performance Management (CAP-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Resource Limiting (AAT-39.24) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Resource Limiting (AAT-39.24) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
